note: Canonical identity and type for the ROUND 2 entity rulings that do not resolve to an already-certified entity, and to the identities round 1 declared. Generated from three list shapes Q pastes verbatim; anything outside them is left held rather than named.
resolutionOrder: 1. the span verbatim against canonical+alias  2. the span with titles, party suffixes, role tails and a leading 'The' removed  3. an initial+surname where exactly one certified person carries that surname  4. a connector split where EVERY part resolves  5. this file  6. refused, and listed in `held`.
typeVocabulary: Only types already present in public/data/entities.json are used. No new type is introduced by this batch.

shapes.Country: Central Bank: audit line from #135-#138 — the country and its central bank, split, both named by Q
shapes.Outlet – Journalist: audit line from #1515 — the outlet and its reporter, split, both named by Q
shapes.Person - Party: audit line from #1319/#1850 — the member and their party, split, both named by Q
